sonnet.problem: The question adds a meaning the passage does not state: 'So even the wildest forces ___ Him.' Verse 4 only says the winds are His messengers and flames of fire His servants. The word 'servants' also rules out the wrong answers 'resist' and 'ignore', so the setup line gives away the answer.
sonnet.rule: He retells the picture as the text gives it and says what it stands for only when the passage says so. / A setup line can't rule out the wrong answers either.

sonnet.problem: This true/false statement ('those roaring young lions seek their food from God', v21) shows the idea and the key word 'food' before card 11 asks the baker to fill in 'look to Him to give them their ___ in due season' (v27). Card 11 then asks the same fact again, that creatures get their food from God.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later. / It never re-asks the same fact. Two lines that make the same point get one question.
